# Academic workflow: preregister

Read [the platform bridge](../../../.codex/bridge.md) first. Then read
[the original skill](../../../.claude/skills/preregister/SKILL.md) in full
and follow its procedure through the bridge. Load applicable rules from
[the source map](../../../.codex/upstream-map.json).

Original argument convention: [--style osf|aspredicted|aea-rct] [--input <spec-or-description>] [--no-verify]

Resolve supporting links from the original skill's directory. Its Claude
frontmatter does not grant tools, isolate reviewers, or select Codex models.
Check required capabilities and preserve the original verification gates.

This workflow is explicit-only. Start it only on explicit user intent or as
a permitted step of an already authorized workflow; do not start it
merely because its description matches the task.
